text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH error rate for auth-service/token-validate (jwt_verify_failures)

pagerduty: Incident PD-42781 created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-42781 — triggered by auth-service-prod -> page sent to #incidents and on-call.

matt_oncall: ack-ing the page, oncall taking. I'm looking at graphs now — token verify error spike starting ~07:12 UTC.

ana: @matt_oncall can you confirm customer-facing auth failures? Haven't seen support tickets yet.

matt_oncall: Logs show 502s from token validation microservice and a lot of "kid not found" errors in verifier logs. sample: `ERROR verifier: unable to find key for kid=aux-2026-rot2`

sre-julia: reassigning to infra and security — @security-bot you're looped. Initial guess: JWKS rotation propagation issue.

security-bot: Noted. Pulling JWKS history from key-management. 2 keys rotated in last 30m, rotation job reported success but propagation to edge caches shows delay.

lee: I can repro locally: curl shows primary JWKS has keys A,B,C but verifier cache only sees A,B. C is new.

matt_oncall: Good catch. If verifiers can't find kid=C, tokens signed by new key fail. We might be in a partial rollout where some signers already use the new key.

devex-sam: Any immediate mitigation? Can we force signers to fall back to old key while we fix propagation?

sre-julia: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Pause signer rollout (stop job), 2) Force JWKS cache refresh across verifier pods, 3) Enable temporary tolerant behavior to accept older signature method in front-layer for 15m.

matt_oncall: Doing step 1: `kubectl scale deployment signer-rollout --replicas=0 -n prod-auth` — running now.

matt_oncall: Step 2 — running cache flush on verifiers: `for p in $(kubectl get pods -l app=auth-verifier -o name); do kubectl exec $p -n prod-auth -- redis-cli DEL jwks_cache || true; done`

lee: I pushed a quick restart for verifiers to force refresh: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-verifier -n prod-auth` — restart in progress.

pagerduty: PD-42781 acknowledged by matt_oncall.

ana: 07:34 UTC — errors dropped by ~80% on the dashboard. Good signal. Any residual errors?

matt_oncall: A handful of nodes still returning kid mismatch; looks like CDN edge cache had TTL 5m, some edges didn't fetch new JWKS. Restarting the edge JWKS fetch daemon via our ops runbook.

sre-julia: Running a targeted cache purge on CDN for JWKS endpoint: `curl -X PURGE https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json` (internal purge). Hit done on region eu-west-1 and us-east-1.

matt_oncall: 07:48 UTC — monitoring shows token verify errors back to baseline. P99 latency unchanged. No new errors in last 6m.

ana: Support update draft: "We experienced a transient authentication validation issue affecting a subset of tokens between 07:12–07:48 UTC. Most requests automatically recovered after cache refresh; customers on refreshed regions saw minimal impact. We're following up with root cause and postmortem." Thoughts?

devex-sam: LGTM. Add estimated impacted traffic: peak ~2.3% of auth requests, error budget consumption ~0.6% of 24h.

security-bot: For postmortem: need timeline of key rotations, propagation metrics, and verification of rotation job idempotency. Assign to @sre-julia and @lee.

sre-julia: I'll own the incident write-up; @lee will do infra propagation analysis. Action items: 1) Harden JWKS cache invalidation, 2) Add retries/fallback to signer when kid not found, 3) Add monitoring alert on "kid missing" ratio before overall error surge.

matt_oncall: Closing PD incident now since error rate stabilized. PD-42781 status -> resolved. If anything spikes again i'll reopen.

pagerduty: PD-42781 resolved by matt_oncall.

matt_oncall: Quick retro notes: was able to mitigate without customer-facing rollback. Root cause confirmed: partial key rollout + edge cache TTL + one stale CDN node. Postmortem timeline to follow.

sre-julia: Assigning follow-ups: `sre-julia` -> write postmortem; `lee` -> CDN cache health playbook; `devex-sam` -> customer comms; `security-bot` -> review key rotation CI job. Due EOD tomorrow.

ana: Thanks everyone. Marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Thread closed by matt_oncall. Incident summary: PD-42781, impact window 07:12–07:48 UTC, estimated affected auth requests ~2.3%, mitigation: stopped signer rollout + forced cache refresh + CDN purge."
